searchText: Hi, all. Recently I did a experimental implementation of the witness spec in hyperledger besu so it generates a witness upon processing a block. It seems straightforward for a full-state miner to generate the witness. I'm just wondering how would it look like for a transaction sender to attach the witness? What does the state trie look like on the transaction sender side and on the miner side? Thanks. 🙂 I think in the first versions of any of these proposals, it would be the miner that adds the witness In order for the tx sender to be able to generate a witness, the tx sender would need to know ahead of time what accounts the transaction can access Which requires access lists Yeah, I wrote about those different witnesses in the regenesis explainer: https://medium.com/@mandrigin/regenesis-explained-97540f457807 but that is not step 1 for sure (at least with the current thinking)
